faults.location: Basement 2, Carpark Zone B near Pillar P-42
faults.fault_description: Intermittent ground fault and device communication error reported on Morley FACP. Sensor optical chamber heavily contaminated with exhaust dust.
faults.cause: Dust accumulation and ingress of vehicular exhaust emissions.
faults.action_taken: Dismantled sensor head, cleaned optical chamber with compressed aerosol, tested sensor sensitivity. Replaced detector with brand new Apollo XP95 optical unit when drift compensation reached maximum threshold.

faults.fault_description: Jockey pump cycling continuously every 4 minutes. System pressure dropping from 11 bar to 8 bar due to weeping union joint and faulty diaphragm.
faults.cause: Mechanical vibration loosening brass union nipple and deteriorated rubber diaphragm.
faults.action_taken: Isolated sensing line, replaced pressure switch union with high-pressure stainless fitting, recalibrated cut-in to 9.5 bar and cut-out to 11.5 bar. Pressure hold verified stable for 45 minutes.
faults.materials_used: 1x Danfoss Pressure Switch KPI-35, 1/2" SS Union, Teflon seal

faults.location: Level 1 Fashion Avenue corridor, near Exit Door 104
faults.fault_description: Tamper alarm activated on panel; glass element broken and safety microswitch bent by trolley impact.
faults.cause: Physical impact during night merchandise delivery.
faults.action_taken: Replaced frangible glass element, realigned internal microswitch lever, tested with test key, panel reset normal.

faults.fault_description: Rubber hose perished with surface cracks; brass shutoff nozzle seized and leaking during test pressurization.
faults.action_taken: Awaiting material requisition approval to replace 30m hose reel assembly and multi-spray nozzle.

reports.work_description: Conducted comprehensive quarterly AMC maintenance covering Morley DXc4 Fire Alarm System, main diesel pump, jockey pump, and zone control valves. Verified 8 loops and tested 45 sample detection devices.
reports.faults_found: 1. FACP standby batteries (2x 12V 17Ah) showed high internal impedance (3.8 yrs old). 2. Contaminated optical detector in B2 car park pillar P-42.
reports.rectifications: Replaced 2 standby batteries with new 12V 17Ah units. Replaced contaminated smoke detector in B2 with new XP95 unit and calibrated loop.
reports.pending_works: Awaiting customer approval to replace worn pressure switch on riser 2.
reports.recommendations: Recommend bi-annual cleaning of car park basement sensors due to heavy vehicular exhaust carbon deposits.
reports.testing_performed: Full audible evacuation drill on Zone 1 & 2. Auto-crank of diesel fire pump initiated from pressure drop test valve; reached rated 14 bar pressure in 12 seconds.
reports.result: System restored to 100% operational condition. Civil Defense remote monitoring unit verified communicating with operational center.
reports.remarks: Routine quarterly service completed according to NFPA 72 & NFPA 25 standards.

reports.system: Diesel Fire Pump Emergency Starting System
reports.work_description: Attended emergency breakdown callout regarding diesel fire pump start failure during automated Sunday test. Replaced failed starter contactor solenoid and installed two 12V 17Ah auxiliary booster batteries. Tested manual emergency start and automatic pressure-drop start. System started on first crank and held 12 bar pressure.
reports.testing_performed: 5 consecutive simulated auto-cranks at 15-second intervals. Auto-shutoff delay timer verified at 10 minutes run cycle.
reports.result: Satisfactory. Pump operational and set in AUTO mode.
reports.remarks: Client instructed to maintain diesel day tank level above 90% at all times.
